rule.PASS: all calls scored and judged, no digest or prompt-digest mismatch, and every check holds for new-lean minus old: (1) strict-match paired difference 95% case-cluster bootstrap lower bound >= -0.05; (2) its point estimate >= -0.05; (3) F-code exact paired difference on the primary label set (cases where the blind second mapper agreed with the author label), 95% lower bound >= -0.10; (4) product/test diagnosis accuracy >= old - 0.05; (5) unsupported claims per answer new-lean - old <= +0.30; (6) new-lean total input tokens <= 0.80 x old.
rule.FAIL: all calls scored and judged and any check false
rule.INCONCLUSIVE: any unscored model call after the retry policy, any unparsed or incomplete judge entry after the judge retry policy, any input or prompt digest mismatch, or a canary report
rule.secondary: new-full minus old and new-lean minus new-full were dropped before the freeze (see revision_drop_new_full); H2 and H3 are not run. F-code differences are also reported, descriptively, on four other sets: all labeled cases, real cases only, authored cases only, and the cases the author marked as a clean fit. free is compared descriptively with the same paired statistics.
rule.wording: A PASS supports exactly one sentence: on these 107 development cases the shipped 3.0.0 lean text was not worse than the 2.0.1 text on zero-tool diagnosis by more than the stated margins, at about the stated share of the input tokens. A FAIL on check 3 with a lower bound below -0.10 is recorded as FAIL and read as 'not proven', not as a measured loss; it is not rescued by a different set or margin. It never supports 'better', 'safer', or any statement about the full workflow.

claim_limits: zero-tool diagnosis from a sanitized excerpt; no tool use, no safety behavior
107 cases (75 real, 32 authored), one host, three repetitions; not a holdout
non-inferiority within the stated margins; no superiority claim
